checks.description: Frontmatter has exactly name and description.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains a name field equal to kickoff-scope and a single rich description sentence with trigger phrases, and no other keys.

checks.description: Scope names both entry points and picks one with the orchestrator.
checks.rule: The scope states the entry point as paid acquisition or owned audience, names both options, and is chosen with the orchestrator rather than silently assumed.

checks.description: Scope lists which of the 9 streams run and the funnel path.
checks.rule: The scope lists the active streams with their owners from runtime/stream-ownership.md and lays out the funnel path from entry through the signup gate into lifecycle, monitoring, and reporting.

checks.description: Scope carries forward the validation ASSUMPTION and OPEN ITEM lists.
checks.rule: The scope inherits the ASSUMPTION and OPEN ITEM lists from brief-validate and names what each open item blocks.

checks.description: No invented budget, target, or schedule to complete a path.
checks.rule: A path blocked on a MISSING needed variable stays flagged; no budget, target, price, or schedule is invented to make the path look complete.

checks.description: No em dash characters anywhere in the skill files.
checks.rule: Neither SKILL.md nor the template nor evals contains the em dash character.

checks.description: Western numerals only and no tatweel.
checks.rule: No Eastern Arabic numerals and no tatweel (kashida) character appear in any file in this skill.
Any framing language speaks to what the reader can build, never to what they lack, per context/brand-voice.md.
